commands.name: !commands
commands.description: Link to the website help page with every chat command and a search box.

commands.name: !pm
commands.description: The current private match name and password (one shared setting; mods change it with !lobbyname / !lobbypass).

commands.name: !register
commands.description: Link your Twitch name to your Epic Games name. Mods can register or fix someone else's.

commands.name: !join
commands.description: Join the queue (must be registered, queue must be open).

commands.name: !leave
commands.description: Leave the queue.

commands.name: !pos
commands.description: Show your place in the queue.

commands.name: !myrank
commands.description: Show your MMR on file and where it came from.

commands.name: !lobby
commands.description: Show the current Blue and Orange teams.

commands.name: !stats
commands.description: Wins, losses and points for you or another player.

commands.name: !topwins
commands.description: Top 5 community-games players by wins (ties broken by points).

commands.name: !queue
commands.description: Queue status. Mods open, close, or clear (clear also closes and ends the lobby).

commands.name: !balance
commands.description: Rotate current players out and build new teams from the queue using the current mode.

commands.name: !match
commands.description: clear = game over: everyone in the match leaves the queue, nobody is pulled in. fill = make teams from the queue, or fill empty slots. queue = put everyone in the match back at the front of the queue. Website: Clear / Fill / Move all ➜ Queue under the teams.

commands.name: !reroll
commands.description: Different teams with the same players. Refills anyone kicked/left from the queue.

commands.name: !win
commands.description: Record the winner and award points. A match can only be scored once.

commands.name: !next
commands.description: Viewers: shows who is next in the queue (read-only). Mods: !next = everyone rotates out. !next blue = record Blue win (if not already) and Blue stays on vs new challengers.

commands.name: !mode
commands.description: How teams are made.

commands.name: !pick
commands.description: In picks mode, after !balance: listed players go Blue, the rest Orange. 'auto' balances instead.

commands.name: !format
commands.description: Team size for the next match.

commands.name: !kick
commands.description: Remove someone from the queue. Follow with !reroll if they were in the lobby.

commands.name: !mmr
commands.description: Your own MMR (mods can look up anybody).

commands.name: !setmmr
commands.description: Manually set MMR (number or rank like gc1, c2, d3). 'auto' goes back to Tracker Network.

commands.name: !first
commands.description: Your First 5 record (1st-5th place counts and total).

commands.name: !firsts
commands.description: Top 5 First 5 leaderboard.

commands.name: !(chat message)
commands.description: First 5 unique chatters claim 1st-5th. Payout via !addpoints every 5 min: 15000 / 10500 / 7500 / 4500 / 3000.

commands.name: !leaderboards
commands.description: Link to the website leaderboards (top gifters, bitters, yappers and watch streaks, all time or by month).

commands.name: !topgifters
commands.description: Top 5 subscription gifters (subs gifted). Add a month (oct, october, 2026-10, this, last) for that month only.

commands.name: !topbits
commands.description: Top 5 bit cheerers, all time or for one month.

commands.name: !topyappers
commands.description: Top 5 chatters by number of chat messages, all time or for one month.

commands.name: !topstreak
commands.description: Top 5 watch streaks people have shared in chat (best streak), all time or for one month. Only people who shared a streak are on the board.

commands.name: !streak
commands.description: The last watch streak someone shared (and their best). Twitch only shows a watch streak when the viewer shares it.

commands.name: !streakrecord
commands.description: The best watch streak someone has shared, with the date.

commands.name: !gifted
commands.description: How many subs you (or someone) gifted in total, and the rank on the gifters board.

commands.name: !bits
commands.description: Total bits cheered, the bits badge tier and the rank on the bits board.

commands.name: !sub
commands.description: Subscription tier, months, streak and Founder status from the subscriber list.

commands.name: !founders
commands.description: Lists the Founders (Twitch Founders Badge holders).

commands.name: !alias
commands.description: One person with several accounts: their gifts, bits, messages and streaks are combined under the main login on the boards. Edits Data\boards\aliases.json.

commands.name: !boards
commands.description: refresh = recompute every leaderboard now and push it to the website. status = people, months and the last push result.

commands.name: !subs
commands.description: import = read any new subscriber-list*.csv (Downloads or Data\subs\incoming) into the subscriber list. status = counts by tier, lapsed, founders.

commands.name: !streaks
commands.description: backfill = read old chat logs for watch streaks people shared (safe to repeat). status = how many people shared one.

commands.name: !names
commands.description: Ask Twitch again for everyone's real display name (capital letters) and update the boards.

commands.name: !lookup
commands.description: Shows everything on record for a person: aliases, subscription, gifts, bits, messages and watch streak.

commands.name: !me
commands.description: Join the tournament wheel while sign-ups are open (also a Join button on the website tournament page).

commands.name: !wheel
commands.description: Run the tournament wheel: sign-ups, the draw, one spin per pick (the last pick reveals itself), team announcements go to chat by themselves.

commands.name: !spin
commands.description: Shortcut for !wheel spin: reveal the next pick (or up to pick n).

commands.name: !practice
commands.description: Rehearse with fake players (practice01...). They fill the queue, matchmaking and the wheel but are never saved or counted anywhere.

commands.name: !koth
commands.description: Switch King of the Hill on or off.

commands.name: !strikes
commands.description: How many strikes you have (3 = cannot join customs), split into permanent (red, never expire) and temporary (orange, one wears off per day).

commands.name: !strike
commands.description: Give a temporary strike (wears off after a day). Add perma, toxicity or slurs for a PERMANENT strike (red, never expires).

commands.name: !unstrike
commands.description: Take a temporary strike away. Add perma to remove a permanent one.

commands.name: !finish
commands.description: End the King of the Hill game: record the winner and rotate the queue.

commands.name: !activity
commands.description: Pick what kind of game the stream is running.

commands.name: !gamemode
commands.description: Rocket League game mode for stats.

commands.name: !setsr
commands.description: Set a Fortnite skill rating.

commands.name: !matchwin
commands.description: Fix the winner of a past match (stats are corrected).

commands.name: !matchdel
commands.description: Remove a past match and take its wins back.

commands.name: !move
commands.description: Move someone in the queue.

commands.name: !out
commands.description: Take a player out of the current match.

commands.name: !in
commands.description: Put a player into a team.

commands.name: !scene
commands.description: Switch the OBS scene.

commands.name: !source
commands.description: Show or hide an OBS source.

commands.name: !obs
commands.description: Automatic OBS scene switching and status.

commands.name: !problems
commands.description: List what the bot found wrong, or clear the list.

commands.name: !check
commands.description: Self-test: problems go to the website log.

commands.name: !forgetme
commands.description: ChattyPinguino forgets everything it remembers about you.

commands.name: !rememberme
commands.description: Let ChattyPinguino remember things about you again.

commands.name: !memory
commands.description: Shows what ChattyPinguino remembers about you.

commands.name: !chatbot
commands.description: Switch ChattyPinguino on or off.

commands.name: !golive
commands.description: Set when the stream starts, for the countdown message.

commands.name: !lobbyname
commands.description: Set (or clear) the private match name PinguinoHelper tells viewers to search.

commands.name: !lobbypass
commands.description: Set (or clear) the private match password PinguinoHelper shares.

commands.name: !pg
commands.description: Quick control of the bots from chat. Everyone else gets no answer.

commands.name: !opinion
commands.description: The bot's private weekly note on what it thinks of a regular (used only to colour its tone; never shown in chat or on the website). <user> whispers you the note. Alias accounts are merged; people who used !forgetme or !optmeout get none.

commands.name: !8ball
commands.description: Ask the magic 8-ball. The bot answers in its own voice and may nod to public things like your sub, watch streak or what chat was just saying. Limited to once every 45 seconds per person.

commands.name: !emote
commands.description: How often an emote from the channel's 7TV set has been used in chat, its rank, the top user and when it was last used.

commands.name: !topemotes
commands.description: The most used 7TV emotes in chat, all time or for one month (oct, 2026-10, last). Emotes that are also everyday words are left out.

commands.name: !timer
commands.description: Chat timers: repeating messages that only run while live, after enough chat, and never closer together than the gap. Survive restarts.

commands.name: !remindme
commands.description: The bot @mentions you in chat when the time is up (1 minute to 24 hours, up to 3 open reminders). Survives restarts.

commands.name: !reminders
commands.description: Your open reminders and when they are due.

commands.name: !cancelreminder
commands.description: Cancel one of your reminders (number from !reminders).

commands.name: !remind
commands.description: Set a reminder for someone else; the bot @mentions them when it is due.

commands.name: !countdown
commands.description: Start the on-stream countdown (the site timer overlay shows it); says a line at zero.

commands.name: !stopwatch
commands.description: On-stream stopwatch.

commands.name: !addtime
commands.description: Add (or with a minus, take off) time on the running countdown.

commands.name: !stoptimer
commands.description: Clear every on-stream timer.

commands.name: !points
commands.description: Your points balance and rank (earned by watching, imported from StreamElements).

commands.name: !watchtime
commands.description: How long you have watched the channel, and your rank.

commands.name: !toppoints
commands.description: Top points holders, all time or for one month.

commands.name: !topwatch
commands.description: Most watch time, all time or for one month.

commands.name: !addpoints
commands.description: Broadcaster only, silent. Adds points (a negative number takes them, never below 0). Hidden: no chat reply, logged.

commands.name: !editpoints
commands.description: Broadcaster only, silent. Sets someone's points to exactly this number. Hidden: no chat reply, logged.

commands.name: !removepoints
commands.description: Take points away from someone.

commands.name: !economy
commands.description: Points system status; import from StreamElements (dry run, then apply with the report id).

commands.name: !rank
commands.description: Rocket League ranks. With no name it shows Innocentpenguin_'s 1v1, 2v2 and 3v3; add a playlist (2s, 2v2, dropshot, heatseek, rumble, hoops...) for just that one. Every playlist is pulled in one tracker call per Epic account and cached for 15 minutes, so extra lookups cost nothing.

commands.name: !setrank
commands.description: Mods update the rank !rank shows. You can also paste a whole 'Ranked 1v1: ... | Ranked 2v2: ...' line.

commands.name: !helper
commands.description: Ask the helper a question about the stream, commands, the queue or the website. It answers in one short line from its knowledge pack and points you to the right page. Once every 30 seconds per person; it stays silent for anyone who opted out or used !unping.

commands.name: !poll
commands.description: Starts a Twitch poll (2-5 options, 15-1800 s). The result is said in chat when it ends.

commands.name: !predict
commands.description: Starts a Twitch prediction. Streamer and mods the streamer allows.

commands.name: !lock
commands.description: Locks the open prediction (no more votes).

commands.name: !resolve
commands.description: Pays out the prediction to the winning outcome.

commands.name: !cancel
commands.description: Cancels the prediction and refunds the points.

commands.name: !slow
commands.description: Slow mode (3-120 s, default 30).

commands.name: !emote-only
commands.description: Emote-only chat on or off.

commands.name: !followers
commands.description: Followers-only chat.

commands.name: !subs-only
commands.description: Subscriber-only chat on or off.

commands.name: !title
commands.description: Changes the stream title.

commands.name: !game
commands.description: Changes the stream category (game).

commands.name: !allow
commands.description: Releases a message AutoMod is holding (the newest one, or the newest from that user).

commands.name: !announce
commands.description: Posts a highlighted Twitch announcement.

commands.name: !marker
commands.description: Adds a stream marker at this moment.

commands.name: !shield
commands.description: Shield mode on or off (streamer only).

commands.name: !ad
commands.description: Runs an ad break after a 30 second warning in chat (streamer only).

commands.name: !vip
commands.description: Makes someone a VIP (streamer only).

commands.name: !unvip
commands.description: Removes someone's VIP (streamer only).

commands.name: !raid
commands.description: Streamer only, and only channels on the raid list. The bot asks you to say !confirm raid within 20 seconds. Never starts by itself.

commands.name: !confirm
commands.description: Confirms the pending raid. Must be typed in Twitch chat.

commands.name: !unraid
commands.description: Cancels the pending raid, or the raid that is counting down.

commands.name: !uptime
commands.description: How long the stream has been live.

commands.name: !downtime
commands.description: How long ago the last stream ended.

commands.description: If you think about it, going into a random stream and asking to 1v1 is like walking into a party you weren'...
